annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "sleep" on page 551 ("The Inquest of Yawn"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within the judicial inquest over the prostrate body of Yawn (Shaun), voices of the dead rising through him, HCE's final confession. During this Age of Men phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net

annotations.annotation_text: Viconian marker "Vicus" on page 551 ("The Inquest of Yawn"): Giambattista Vico's cyclical philosophy — divine, heroic, and human ages followed by thundering ricorso — structures this passage within the judicial inquest over the prostrate body of Yawn (Shaun), voices of the dead rising through him, HCE's final confession. The current Age of Men phase shapes the language, institutional imagery, and historical echoes of the dream.
sources: Beckett, Samuel. Dante... Bruno. Vico.. Joyce. https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
